counts.job_count: Number of eligible postings after all active filters.
counts.analyzable_description_count: Filtered postings where description_analyzable is true.
counts.mention_count: Unique eligible postings with the skill in either skill array and an analyzable description.
counts.mention_rate: mention_count divided by analyzable_description_count; null when the denominator is zero.

skill_handling.empty_skill_selection: all ids present in the filtered sample
